Senior Specialist, Project Management

City:  Copenhagen V

Country/Region:  DK

Application Deadline:  N/A

Ready to deliver high-impact projects that shape Pandora’s retail experience?

As a Senior Specialist, Project Management, you’ll play a key role in driving strategic initiatives within Pandora’s Store Creative & Design team. Based at our Copenhagen HQ, this role offers a unique opportunity to combine analytical thinking with creative vision, ensuring projects are delivered with excellence and enable markets to execute flawlessly.

Strategy meets execution and collaboration

In this role, you will support the successful delivery of high-impact projects and strategic workstreams that require close cross-functional collaboration. You’ll work alongside the Senior Manager to define and execute SC&D’s strategic priorities, ensuring best-in-class project management practices across the organization. From developing tools and trackers to preparing business cases and high-quality presentations, you’ll help maintain clarity and alignment at every stage.

You’ll also build strong partnerships across Marketing, Retail Excellence, Supply Chain, and global market teams, acting as a trusted advisor and key point of escalation. This is an exciting opportunity to influence Pandora’s global retail strategy and contribute to creating memorable brand environments for our customers.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Driving and supporting projects and strategic workstreams from kick-off to implementation and testing

• Defining project scope and plans in collaboration with functional experts and stakeholders

• Preparing business cases to evaluate benefits, costs, and risks of alternative options

• Facilitating cross-functional collaboration and problem-solving to meet deadlines

• Delivering regular updates to senior stakeholders, including key findings and recommendations

• Maintaining a full overview of SC&D projects and status trackers for clear communication

• Creating high-quality presentations for SC&D leadership and other stakeholders

• Establishing and role-modelling best-in-class project management practices

• Building strong relationships across global and market teams to ensure alignment

To succeed in this role, you’ll bring:

• A Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Strategy, Finance, Economics, or related field

• 3–5 years of experience in strategic project management within Marketing, Retail, Consulting, or Business Development

• Proven ability to manage complex projects with strategic importance

• Strong analytical skills and experience creating business cases

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics

• Experience engaging with senior stakeholders and facilitating meetings independently

• Background in jewellery, retail, fashion, or FMCG is a plus

• Experience working in a global organization

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills

• Fluent in Business English

Your new team

You’ll join Pandora’s Store Creative & Design team, a creative and strategic group within Global Marketing dedicated to designing desirable brand environments and delivering exceptional customer experiences. From our Copenhagen HQ, we collaborate across functions and markets to bring Pandora’s vision to life.

Additional information

Global career band: 5A

Did we get your attention?

If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply by attaching your CV and portfolio. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion in 2025.

**Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Key account manager to our Commercial organization.

****About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

**Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Key Account Manager who wants to make a difference.

**The Role

**At Truesec Denmark, we're on the lookout for an experienced Key Account Manager to drive our continued growth by winning new business and nurturing strong relationships with our great customers. As one of the primary points of contact, you will ensure our customers remain satisfied while we drive our business forward with high professionalism. You will cover customers in all of Denmark however the majority of your key accounts will be in Jutland. You will also:

• Create new business: Take the initiative and discover new opportunities to expand our customer portfolio. You will have freedom to set goals and initiatives that makes the Danish team perform even better than today.

• Build & retain relationships: Develop and maintain strong bonds with our customers, ensuring their needs are consistently met.

• Understand customer & market needs: Gain deep insights into our customers’ business goals and cybersecurity requirements in general.

• Drive growth: Identify chances to expand existing partnerships through upselling and cross-selling.

• Collaborate internally: Work closely with our teams to ensure we deliver solutions that exceed customer expectations.

• Monitor and report: Keep an eye on customer satisfaction, account performance, and market trends, and share your insights with the team.

• Stay informed: Keep up with the latest industry trends, emerging threats, and competitive developments to always offer the best advice.

**Your Potential Background

**To succeed in this role, we believe that you

• Bring extensive experience from the cybersecurity industry.

• Have a proven success as a Key Account Manager or in a similar client-facing role, ideally within the cybersecurity sector.

• Demonstrate exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, fostering strong connections with clients and stakeholders.

• Possess a proactive, results-oriented attitude and thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

• Excel in organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.

• Have a track record of building and maintaining long-term, trusted client relationships.

• Tackles challenges with a solution-driven mindset and remains composed under pressure.

• Are proficient in CRM tools (preferably Hubspot) and skilled in using the Microsoft Office Suite.

• Exhibit business-level fluency in reading, writing, and speaking both Danish and English.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish or Swedish citizenship or citizenship in an EU country.

**Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

**If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A STRATEGIC AND CULTURE-DRIVEN HEAD OF PR TO JOIN OUR PR & COMMS TEAM IN COPENHAGEN. THIS ROLE DEFINES AND LEADS OUR GLOBAL PUBLIC RELATIONS STRATEGY AND EXECUTION

**Your Mission & Responsibilities Ahead Of You

**You will be responsible for defining and executing GANNI’s global PR strategy across all markets, ensuring a strong and consistent brand presence while allowing for local relevance. This includes leading seasonal storytelling, key brand moments and global campaigns that shape how GANNI shows up in culture.

A key part of the role is overseeing all global media and press relations, building and maintaining strong relationships with international editors, journalists and opinion leaders, while managing press calendars, media lists, press releases and global announcements. You will also lead the PR strategy for key events including Fashion Week, brand activations, collaborations and special projects, working closely with internal teams and external partners to bring brand moments to life.

In addition, you will manage and coordinate local PR agencies across key markets (UK, US, CHINA), ensuring clear alignment, strong execution and consistent performance through defined KPIs and reporting frameworks.

The role further includes defining and leading the global talent and cultural partnerships strategy, building and maintaining strong relationships with international key opinion leaders and cultural voices aligned with the brand. You will own and manage the global PR budget, while continuously tracking and analysing PR performance, media impact and brand visibility, translating insights into actionable improvements.

**Must Have Requirements

**We are looking for a candidate with strong experience within PR and communications, who is comfortable operating in a fast-paced, international and creative environment. You are both strategic and hands-on, with a strong ability to turn vision into execution.

• Solid experience in PR and communications, ideally within fashion, luxury or lifestyle brands

• Proven experience leading global PR strategies and working across international markets

• Strong network within global fashion, lifestyle and cultural media

• Experience managing agencies and cross-regional teams

• Strategic thinker with a hands-on, execution-driven mindset

• Strong storytelling, communication and relationship-building skills

• English fluent (mandatory), Danish or other languages a plus

**THE GANNI WAY

We are looking for a true GANNI ambassador - someone who shares our values of Openness (ready to evolve, honest not perfect), Optimism** (you never stand still, just dance!), Authenticity (you march at your own beat!), Accountability (no excuses, you make an impact) & Responsibility (make small changes, see big differences).

The GANNI culture is based on a learning and results-driven mentality, where everyone is united by a common purpose of (hack)the fashion system!

GANNI is a state of mind - more than a way of dressing and we love to change the usual practice in everything we do. We are confident and capable of anything! So prepare yourself to be comfortable with the uncomfortable and hacking the system together with our amazing PR & Comms team!

**DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

**At GANNI, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, racial identity, religious belief, disability status, or personal expression.

We believe that diversity drives creativity and innovation, and we are dedicated to building a team that reflects the world around us.

To support unbiased hiring, we kindly ask you not to include your photo, age, or marital status in your CV - we’re only interested in why you’re a great fit for the role.

**BE BOLD AND JOIN OUR GANNI COMMUNITY!

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel motivated to join our team and become a part of the GANNI community.

We will be interviewing candidates continuously and kindly ask you to send your application and CV as soon as possible. Please use the “Apply for position” button.

**MORE GANNI GOODIES

**You will be working out of our unique GANNI house located in the beautiful City Center of Copenhagen on top of the Bremerholm flagship store. Besides our amazing and colorful new office facilities, we are also proud of our inhouse GANNI kitchen that offers healthy and sustainable food cooked by our passionate in-house chef.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our new Senior Heat Plate Design Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Danfoss' gasketed plate heat exchanger (GPHE) portfolio.

As a senior member of the GPHE New Product Development team, you will drive the development of complete product solutions from concept through production release, helping deliver products that combine strong performance, reliability, quality, and cost competitiveness.

Beyond delivering innovative products, you will contribute your expertise to strengthening the team's technical capabilities. You will act as a mentor and sparring partner for colleagues across development projects, sharing knowledge, supporting complex technical problem solving, and helping the team build on proven engineering practices and lessons learned.

This role is ideal for an experienced product development engineer who enjoys combining hands-on engineering with technical depth and who is motivated by creating solutions that improve energy efficiency and support sustainable applications worldwide.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**As part of our GPHE New Product Development team, you will lead the development of complete GPHE products from concept through launch and industrialization.

**Key Responsibilities Include

**

• Lead the development of GPHE products from concept creation through validation, industrialization, and successful production release

• Translate customer, market, and business needs into robust product requirements and technical solutions

• Develop and optimize GPHE product architectures to achieve performance, reliability, manufacturability, compliance, and cost targets

• Drive design activities including simulation, prototyping, testing, validation, DFMEA, technical risk management, and problem-solving throughout the product lifecycle

• Provide technical guidance and mentoring to colleagues while collaborating across global cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution and knowledge sharing.

In your day-to-day work, you will partner closely with specialists in thermal, hydraulic, and mechanical engineering while contributing to technical reviews, design validation activities, and continuous product improvement initiatives.

**What We're Looking For

**To be successful in this role, you will bring a strong combination of engineering expertise, product development experience, and a collaborative mindset.

**Essential Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, Product Development, or a related engineering discipline

• Significant experience developing mechanical products from concept through production release and industrialization, preferably within heat exchangers, pressure equipment, industrial products, or similar engineered solutions

• Strong experience with mechanical product design and 3D CAD development, including sheet metal or formed component design

• Proven ability to independently drive complex technical development activities and influence engineering decisions across cross-functional projects

• Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to mentor colleagues and work effectively in a global engineering environment

**Preferred Qualifications

**Experience with GPHE products, thermal systems, heat transfer technologies, simulation-driven development, DFMEA, design validation, and design-for-manufacturing principles would be considered an advantage.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who enjoys combining deep technical expertise with collaboration and knowledge sharing. You naturally take ownership of complex engineering challenges, help develop those around you, and maintain a holistic view of product development while balancing performance, manufacturability, quality, and cost.

**What You'll Get From Us

**At Danfoss, you'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with advanced heat transfer technologies and develop products that improve energy efficiency across a wide range of industrial applications. You will collaborate with experts in thermal engineering, virtual engineering, laboratory testing, manufacturing, and quality, gaining exposure across the full product development lifecycle while helping shape the next generation of GPHE solutions.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**Job Description Summary

**The General Manager, Business & Commercial Operations for Surgical Innovations (SI) will lead the strategy and execution of the people, processes, and technologies that enable a differentiated customer experience and strong commercial and operational performance. With responsibility across Surgery and Surgical Visualization & Guidance (SVG/legacy bk Medical), this leader will bring together currently separate functional teams into one integrated SI Business & Commercial Operations organization.

The role will oversee OTR/Sales Operations, Demo Operations, Contracting, GPO & National Accounts, Logistics, and Commercial Excellence. As a key business partner, the GM will drive integration, standardization, and simplification across commercial processes, strengthen execution and operational rigor, and identify opportunities to improve the way SI serves its customers and supports its commercial teams.

Through strong cross-functional leadership and a continuous improvement mindset, the GM will build scalable processes and capabilities that enable profitable growth, improve the customer experience, and accelerate execution of the Surgical Innovations strategy.

**Job Description

**Essential Responsibilities:

The role will lead and direct the following tasks and activities:

• Lead and integrate the SI Business & Commercial Operations organization, combining SVG and Surgery functional teams into one structure: OTR/Sales Operations, Demo Operations, Contracting, GPO & National Accounts, Logistics, and Commercial Excellence

• Drive commercial intensity by working as part of a unified team focused on profitable growth through commercial and operational KPIs, forecast accuracy, and sales force effectiveness

• Provide strategic commercial insights to drive growth and support SI leadership to make profitable decisions regarding standard work, training, commercial deployment and resource optimization

• Improve and strengthen SI’s winning culture and growth mindset through simplification and adoption of commercial processes

• Manage order and sales forecasting, as well as revenue management, at the regional and segment levels

• Drive backlog quality, sales and installation quality, and conversion acceleration

• Lead OTR/Sales Operations, including demand planning and order fulfillment in partnership with global supply chain and logistics

• Lead orders and sales management operating mechanisms and coordinate commercial implementation

• Oversee pricing delegation of authority to ensure profitable pricing strategy, inclusive of monthly and quarterly reporting on pricing performance in partnership with Finance

• Manage regional pricing approval processes and support any strategic pricing initiatives

• Support deal structuring for strategic deals and partnerships to ensure the optimal solution is offered to the customer while supporting profitable growth

• Lead Commercial Contracting and Request for Proposal processes across SI to ensure timely answers to customer requests

• Lead distribution management, including distributor contracts and due diligence

• Ensure proactive, coordinated communication with customers during order fulfillment issues

• Lead the transition to Apttus, ensuring effective process and system adoption

• Establish and lead GPO & National Accounts management for all of SI

• Lead Demo Operations across SI

• Own SI commercial data and reporting quality, including Salesforce.com data integrity, reporting efficiency, funnel forecasting, and Dynamics

• Drive commercial readiness and operational support for Lighthouse NPIs

• Enhance Heartbeat practices and mindset across SI to increase standard work across Commercial, Operations, and Finance and improve margin, speed, and growth.

**Qualifications/Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s degree & 10 + years of experience in business management, sales, or marketing, OR equivalent years of experience in operations with progressive leadership in the healthcare industry.

• Demonstrated ability to drive and execute results through rigorous operating mechanisms in a matrixed GE HealthCare environment, often working across partner functions and other business organizations

• Exemplary people management, leadership, and communication skills, as well as sales coaching and team-building experience

• Strong business acumen; financial, organizational, compliance, negotiation, problem-solving, and influencing skills

• Impactful executive presence - high-level presentation and interpersonal skills; able to communicate and present ideas to customers in a way that produces understanding and impact and builds effective strategic relationships

• Ability to energize, develop, and build rapport, collaboration and influence at all levels within an organization

• U.S. or Europe Based

• 40% Travel

Desired Characteristics

• Previous experience leading service and/or sales for GEHC product portfolio

• Ability to influence and collaborate with senior-level management teams

• Direct and/or indirect management experience; managing in a matrix

• Experience with commercial contracting, GPO/National Accounts, and pricing in the healthcare industry

• Experience leading business integrations and combining organizations, processes, and systems (e.g., Salesforce.com, Apttus, EOM, Oracle)

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership –always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $172,000.00-$258,000.00 Annual. GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

******Additional Information

******GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Ambu is redefining the future of endoscopy with a bold vision to become the global leader in the field. As part of this ambition, we aim to be at the forefront of commercial execution.

As our new Global Marketing Communications Manager, GI & ENT, you will drive the global communication strategy and execution for our GI (Gastroenterology) & ENT (Ear-Nose-Throat) business areas.

Based at our headquarters in Ballerup, Denmark, you will work closely with our Downstream Product Management team, as well as our Brand & Creation team, Digital Marketing Specialists, Medical Affairs, and local sales organizations to develop customer-centric, evidence-driven, and commercially impactful communication activities.

You will develop and optimize communication throughout the customer journey and translate customer insights, business priorities, and market opportunities into communication that drives engagement and business results.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Drive the development and execution of global communication activities for GI & ENT, translating commercial priorities, customer insights, and clinical evidence into impactful campaigns, content, and sales enablement tools.

• Develop sales enablement materials and content that empower local commercial teams and strengthen engagement with healthcare professionals

• Partner closely with Downstream Product Management on global product launches, campaigns, and commercial initiatives, supporting launch communication, campaign development, and sales enablement activities.

• Collaborate with the Digital Marketing team to identify performance insights and continuously optimize communication activities.

• Work closely with the Brand & Creation team to deliver sales and marketing materials that are both on-brand and commercially effective.

**What We Are Looking For

**You are a commercially minded marketer who enjoys translating business objectives into effective communication and marketing activities. You are proactive and thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment

Most importantly, you are motivated by helping others succeed. You get energy from enabling our frontline sales teams with the tools and communication they need to create value for customers and win in the market.

**Skills

**_Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you have:

_

• 6+ years of experience in commercial marketing, marketing communications, or related roles, preferably gained in an agency environment.

• Proven commercial experience within MedTech, Pharma, or other healthcare-related industries.

• Experience developing communication strategies, campaigns, and sales enablement initiatives that support business growth.

• Strong ability to translate customer, market, and business insights into impactful communication.

• A driven, hands-on approach, a strong sense of ownership, and a genuine passion to help local commercial teams succeed.

• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across functions and geographies.

• A proactive mindset with the ability to drive new initiatives and continuously improve how we engage customers and stakeholders.

• A degree in Marketing, Business, or related field.

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is on an ambitious growth journey, expanding globally and pushing the boundaries of innovation in healthcare. Here, your contributions will directly shape our success. You'll work in an international head office with a collaborative, open culture where ideas matter and impact is visible.

We offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits along with exciting job challenges and career opportunities contributing to your job satisfaction.

We are looking for a Financial Controller to lead the operational and analytical work behind our monthly close, group consolidation, project controlling and control environment of a fast-growing energy trading and technology group – and to rebuild them AI-first, so our numbers are faster, more reliable and ready for scale.

Why this role matters

Hybrid Greentech is scaling fast as a VPP, BRP and electricity retailer across Denmark, and Northern Europe. Energy trading means large and volatile daily revenue, cost and cash transactions – so quality , accuracy and liquidity control are not back-office topics; they decide how fast we can grow. This role exists to give management, the board and investors numbers they can trust, on time, and to build controls and automation that scale with the business rather than with headcount. The same discipline is needed in our consultancy arm, where technical consultants deliver advisory and EPC management projects: clear project economics, timely invoicing and early warning when a project drifts.

The role

As Financial Controller, you report to our Finance Manager and work closely with the CFO and our accountant in a small, hands-on finance team. You lead the operational and analytical work within the financial steering, reporting and finance and business analytics; running the month-end close, the consolidation of our group entities in Denmark and abroad, balance sheet reconciliations, project controlling and the day-to-day operation of our internal controls. This is an individual contributor role with high ownership and direct visibility towards management.

You will work in close collaboration with our settlement team, project managers and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting, partner with our accountant on more complex accounting topics, and work across trading, portfolio management, commercial and engineering. We are a tech-first company with high AI adoption, and we expect you to work that way too: AI tools, scripting and automation are your default approach to removing manual work from close, reconciliation and reporting – combined with the judgement to know when a number needs a human review.

What you will do

• Lead and execute the monthly close and group consolidation, including account mapping, intercompany eliminations, reconciliations and variance analysis, and prepare the monthly financial and business review for the CFO, management and the board.

• Set up and run project controlling – project budgets, hours and utilisation, work in progress, milestone and fixed-fee revenue recognition and timely invoicing – giving project managers and business owners clear steering on margin, estimate-to-complete and cash.

• Automate and rebuild our reporting flow – from ERP trial balances to consolidated P&L, balance sheet and cash flow – using AI tools, scripting and data pipelines, replacing manual spreadsheet steps with controlled, repeatable and documented processes.

• Operate and strengthen our internal controls within the framework set by the Finance Manager, including segregation of duties, payment and bank authorisations and documented business procedures, and drive follow-up on auditor recommendations.

• In close collaboration with Settlement, ensure trading-related balances – settlement, imbalance costs, customer prepayments and deposits, and collateral posted to TSOs, DSOs and exchanges – are correctly recognized, invoiced and reconciled

• Support cash and liquidity forecasting and management with the Finance Manager and CFO, including rolling cash forecasts, collateral and trading risk capital tracking, and early warning on cash exposure.

• Prepare and analyse the annual budget and monthly forecast updates for the Finance Manager and CFO, maintaining our driver-based budget model and following up on budget-versus-actual deviations with business owners.

• Handle key accounting areas such as revenue recognition and accruals, capitalisation of development projects, grant periodisation and month-end cost accruals, collaborating with our accountant on more complex accounting topics.

• Support in the year-end close and audit for all group entities, including annual reports, tax specifications and intercompany agreements, in close collaboration with Finance Manager and our external auditors.

• Work closely with our Settlement team and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting – turning data into insight on gross profit by revenue stream, cost of execution and unit economics, and building dashboards that let the business self-serve.

What you bring

Experience and skills (Required)

• 5+ years of experience as a controller, in audit or in a group finance role, ideally in a multi-entity set-up.

• A relevant degree in accounting, finance or economics (e.g. cand.merc., HD-R or cand.merc.aud.).

• Proven hands-on experience running month-end close, consolidation and year-end audit under the Danish Financial Statements Act (Årsregnskabsloven)

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems, preferably e-conomic

• Solid understanding of balance sheet accounting, revenue recognition, capitalised development costs, accruals and intercompany transactions.

• Experience with project controlling – budgets, work in progress, utilisation and project margin follow-up – ideally in a consultancy, engineering, Trading or EPC business.

• A genuine AI-first way of working: you use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot daily and can show concrete examples of finance processes you have automated (e.g. with Python, SQL, Power Query, APIs or low-code tools).

• Strong Excel and financial modelling skills combined with a structured, control-minded approach and high attention to detail.

• The ability to work independently in a fast-paced scale-up, prioritise under pressure and explain financial matters clearly to non-finance colleagues.

• Language: English (required); Danish

Nice to have

• Experience from energy trading, utilities, commodities or financial services – e.g. settlement, collateral, imbalance or margin processes.

• Experience with e-conomic, time registration or PSA tools, ERP migration to a more scalable platform, and BI tools such as Power BI.

Your influence will be felt far beyond individual projects. By helping markets make better marketing decisions and focus on the opportunities that matter most, you'll contribute directly to stronger brand performance, greater local relevance, and sustainable business growth across Pandora.

What You'll Bring

You'll Thrive in This Role If You Have

• 
Significant senior marketing experience, typically gained over 10+ years, within global FMCG, retail, fashion, or consumer brands.

• 
A proven track record of building brands and delivering measurable commercial results.

• 
Strong experience developing and executing integrated marketing strategies across local or regional markets.

• 
Deep expertise in brand planning, consumer insights, business analysis, and marketing performance management.

• 
The ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment in a matrix organisation.

• 
A strategic mindset combined with a pragmatic, action-oriented approach.

• 
Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

It Would Be a Bonus If You Also Bring

• 
Experience working across multiple international markets.

• 
Additional language skills.

• 
Experience leading large-scale transformation or capability-building initiatives.

What We Offer You

At Pandora, you'll join a global team that believes great ideas can come from anywhere. You'll have the opportunity to influence marketing performance across markets, partner with talented colleagues around the world, and play a key role in shaping the future of one of the world's most recognisable brands.

We offer a collaborative and inclusive culture, exciting global challenges, and opportunities for professional growth where your impact can truly be seen.

Ready to Create the Extraordinary?

If you're passionate about driving marketing excellence through partnership, insight, and collaboration, we'd love to hear from you.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

maria@assistance.dk

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The Global Talent Management Lead is responsible for setting the standard for how JOE identifies, develops and moves talent, ensuring that internal mobility and leadership readiness are predictable, data-driven and scalable across the organization. The role owns the talent review and development planning approach for operational and office-based roles, the talent management system and pipeline reporting, and partners with Culture, Performance & Reward, Operations, People Business Partners and regional T&LD to shape decisions on where and how talent is built. As part of the Talent & Leadership Development team within People & Development, this position is critical to the ambition of filling 90% of leadership roles from within, supporting JOE's purpose and growth ambitions.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Set the company-wide standard for talent development, owning a regular and objective talent review process for operational and office-based roles, anchored in individual development plans.

• Shape and own the roll-out of the talent development model, starting with operational roles from Juicer to Store Manager and scaling quickly to office-based roles, with SOPs that work consistently across all regions.

• Own the strategy, selection and implementation of the talent management system, ensuring it connects with shared learning platforms and provides one source of truth for talent data.

• Own pipeline reporting and insight - internal fill rate, successor coverage, development plan completion and employee development experience - informing strategic people and growth decisions at leadership level.

• Ensure pipeline gaps are identified early and closed across all regions, steering gap-closing actions with People Business Partners and regional T&LD.

• Own visible career pathways and promotion criteria across the organization, so employees can see their next step from day one.

• Partner with Culture, Performance & Reward and Operations to set aligned leadership standards, competency framework and people cycle, acting as the organization's thought leader on talent development.

• Contribute to pipeline-fill initiatives, such as structured mentoring, that turn talent review outcomes into concrete development actions.

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• Passionate about developing talent. A standard-setter who builds career pathways and talent development processes that work the same way in every region and every role

• Data-led: you turn pipeline numbers into insight that leaders act on

• Operationally credible: you understand how careers are built from the bar to the office

• A partner who influences across Culture, Performance & Reward, Operations, People Business Partners and regional T&LD without needing authority

• A thought leader who works with high autonomy and shapes how we build leaders

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 7+ years in talent management, talent development or people development roles, ideally in global multi-site quick service restaurant, retail or similar front line heavy industry

• Proven track record owning talent review-, succession planning- and individual development plan processes

• Experience selecting and implementing a talent management system, incl. integration with learning platforms

• Strong analytical skills: pipeline reporting, internal fill rate and successor coverage

• Experience designing competency frameworks, career pathways and promotion criteria

• Experience rolling out global processes and SOPs across regions and markets

• Fluent in English - other languages are a bonus

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

**Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

****ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Are you commercially minded, confident with complex contracts and interested in a role that goes far beyond simply reviewing legal terms?

Join Accenture’s Contract Management team in Denmark, where you’ll help some of our key client accounts turn signed agreements into successful, well-managed partnerships. You’ll work primarily post-signature, interpreting complex agreements, resolving contractual grey areas, managing amendments and work orders, and ensuring commercial commitments are understood and delivered.

What you’ll do

• Own and manage contracts throughout the post-signature lifecycle

• Advise on contractual interpretation, amendments and new work orders

• Track deliverables, client sign-off, payment and commercial commitments

• Partner with client stakeholders and internal Legal, Finance, Commercial and Delivery teams

• Help protect Accenture’s contractual and commercial position

• Explore how AI and automation can make contract management smarter and more efficient

What we’re looking for

• 5+ years of relevant contract management experience (ideally IT related contracts)

• A legal or commercial-legal background (Master's degree in Law)

• Strong experience with complex contracts and client-facing stakeholder management

• Danish or another Nordic language, with the ability to work effectively with Danish contracts

• Based in Denmark or willing to relocate

What’s in it for you?

You’ll gain exposure to complex, high-value client work, collaborate across Denmark and the wider Nordic and Netherlands Contract Management community, and have variety beyond a single account. You’ll also join a forward-looking team investing in AI-enabled Contract Management, with the opportunity to develop towards Contract Management Lead level over the coming years. The working model is flexible, with the team typically connecting in person around once a week.

Ready to bring legal thinking and commercial judgement together? We’d love to hear from you.
